title: Private Key West Sandbar and Paddle by Boat
includes: Contact us the day before and let us know if you'd like kayaks or paddle boards or a combo. You'll paddle on your own but your captain will provide any needed instruction
we have floating rafts for lounging
The capt usually has her dog (unless it's an issue for you). Your dog is welcome!!
On board cooler for your drinks and snacks you bring
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Guests must know how to swim
policies: Customers should bring sun protection (hat, long sleeves, sunglasses, reef safe sunscreen) and a sense of adventure!
guests enter water and get back on boat via ladder
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a private half day adventure for up to 6 guests aboard our late model pontoon boat. Guests may discover and observe diverse marine habitats and wildlife refuges as well as spot an abundance of marine birds and sea life. Paddle on your own via kayak or paddleboard through natural, winding, mangrove lined tidal creeks and then relax on a sandbar or island on one of our floats. Bring your own snacks and drinks and your dog!
